name: Somaliland
famous_for: Laas Geel prehistoric rock art (among Africa's best preserved cave paintings), camel market in Hargeisa, and historic Berbera port.
tourists: Approx. 20,000 heritage travelers; famous for 5,000-year-old colorful bovine rock paintings of Laas Geel and Daallo mountain forest.
must_know: The camel is deeply revered in Somaliland, serving as a pillar of nomadic wealth, milk production, and oral poetic lore.
fun_fact: The cave paintings at Laas Geel date back between 5,000 and 11,000 years and retain strikingly vibrant red, white, and yellow pigments.
